Mark P35 and populate P14T and P17T only where the notification revises a previously submitted period, and note that the corrected period may differ from the submission period. Be clear which route applies: the Rules describe correction of already-accepted data through the PT electronic request annexes PT-SAM3SD, PT-SAM3SD-M and PT-SAM3SDP (points 86.6-86.8), with the corrected period stated in the annex (point 92.4) and only the affected insured persons listed (points 95.4 and 96.4). The on-form P35 flag and the PT route are not interchangeable and the choice should be confirmed with SODRA before either is automated.

Mark P35 and populate P14T and P17T only where the notification revises a previously submitted period, and note that the corrected period may differ from the submission period. Be clear which route applies: the Rules describe correction of already-accepted data through the PT electronic request annexes PT-SAM3SD, PT-SAM3SD-M and PT-SAM3SDP (points 86.6-86.8), with the corrected period stated in the annex (point 92.4). P35 belongs to the written (paper) correction route (points 93-97): the employer files a written request together with a new SAM marked 'x' in P35 (points 93-94), P14T and P17T give the corrected year and month (points 95.1-95.2), and the annexes list only the insured persons whose data change (points 95.3-95.4; points 96.3-96.4 for quarters up to 2009-12-31). The on-form P35 flag and the PT route are not interchangeable and the choice should be confirmed with SODRA before either is automated.

Points 8 and 249: SD notifications are submitted as an electronic document through the employer's Sodra account (EDAS); employer systems may also send them automatically through the Sodra DataService web service (SOAP 1.2/MTOM, https://draudejai.sodra.lt/edas-external/services/DataService: uploadEdasDraft for an unsigned draft, sendSignedDocument for a signed file, getDocumentStatus for acceptance or rejection). Point 250 and the SAM v07 data structure description (DSA, V-243 in the V-624 wording): the notification is an FFData XML file in that structure (see File Structure); the DataService instruction (p. 8) requires UTF-8 without BOM. The file must be signed with a qualified electronic signature by the manager or an authorised person (Sodra page on electronic notifications). Point 52 sets the deadline at the 15th of the following calendar month and requires a PT electronic request with correction reason code 01 where SAM is filed late. Point 84.1 notes the employer is informed of acceptance through EDAS.

Point 8: SD notifications are submitted as an electronic document through the employer's Sodra account (EDAS); employer systems may also send them automatically through the Sodra DataService web service (SOAP 1.2/MTOM, https://draudejai.sodra.lt/edas-external/services/DataService: uploadEdasDraft for an unsigned draft, sendSignedDocument for a signed file, getDocumentStatus for acceptance or rejection). Point 8 and the SAM v07 data structure description (DSA, annex 'SAM aprašas v07' to V-243, in the V-624 wording): the notification is an FFData XML file in that structure (see File Structure); the DataService instruction (p. 8) requires UTF-8 without BOM. The file must be signed with a qualified electronic signature (point 8) by the manager or an authorised person (Sodra page on electronic notifications). Point 52 sets the deadline at the 15th of the following calendar month and requires a PT electronic request with correction reason code 01 where SAM is filed late. Point 84.1: the employer is informed through EDAS of the territorial branch decision on data correction or on not recording the submitted data (within 3 working days, point 84); acceptance of the SAM file itself is shown by the DataService status (getDocumentStatus).

Electronic signature certificate expiring before the deadline; deadline falling on a weekend or public holiday (point 125 moves the end of the deadline to the next working day for SD notifications, which include SAM under point 4.7); file written with a BOM or in another encoding; submission rejected on a C1xxx structural error after the deadline; DataService status ERR (rejected with errors) or the service blocked after 5 failed logins.

Month in which cumulative income crosses EUR 138 729,00 (2026): above it a 0 % rate applies to the contributions charged at the rates approved by the annual budget-indicators law, and PSD is outside the ceiling (I-1336 art. 10(9); XV-632 art. 3-4); whether the Guarantee Fund, the Long-term Employment Benefit Fund and the 3 % pension accumulation also stop at the ceiling is an open item (no source read); employee already capped in an earlier month; employee below the MMA EUR 1 153 with no exception applying (top-up base) versus one with an exception (no top-up); part-month employee where the MMA is prorated by working days (art. 10(8)); negative retro adjustment exceeding the month's insurable income; insured category changing mid-month while P3 stays at the month-start value; half-up rounding difference of one cent tripping C2344; employee paid only excluded income types, leaving A11 at zero; annual leave pay spanning two months, which point 51.4 splits by calendar month.

Month in which cumulative income crosses EUR 138 729,00 (2026): above it a 0 % rate applies to the contributions charged at the rates approved by the annual budget-indicators law, and PSD is outside the ceiling (I-1336 art. 10(9); XV-632 art. 3-4); in the month the ceiling is crossed the SAM keeps A12 = A11 x P3 and Sodra recalculates automatically and notifies the new rate (see C7); position on what continues above the ceiling: the Guarantee Fund 0,16 % (Law XII-2604 art. 5(3)), the Long-term Employment Benefit Fund 0,16 % (art. 14(3)) and, for participants, the 3 % pension accumulation contribution (Law IX-1691 art. 8(1)) are charged on the income on which social insurance contributions are calculated, at rates set by those laws and not by the budget-indicators law, so they continue above the ceiling together with PSD 6,98 %; employee already capped in an earlier month; employee below the MMA EUR 1 153 with no exception applying (top-up base) versus one with an exception (no top-up); part-month employee where the MMA is prorated by working days (art. 10(8)); negative retro adjustment exceeding the month's insurable income; insured category changing mid-month while P3 stays at the month-start value; half-up rounding difference of one cent tripping C2344; employee paid only excluded income types, leaving A11 at zero; annual leave pay spanning two months, which point 51.4 splits by calendar month.

Points 95.4 and 96.4 add that in a correction the SAM3SDP annex lists ONLY the insured whose information changes, not the whole population.

XML element ManagerFullName, 68 cells. Composite Key: the MXFD comment and the printed form legend both define box 13 as 'vardas, pavarde' - first name AND surname - carried in ONE 68-character field, so the value must be assembled from two source attributes rather than mapped from a single column, and it routinely exceeds 8 characters. Note that SODRA keeps the insured person's names in SEPARATE fields A4V and A4P on the annexes, so the same employer must concatenate here and split there. The printed legend adds '(parasas)' - signature - to this box; in the electronic route the handwritten signature is replaced by the qualified electronic signature applied to the whole FFData file, which point 88 and the signing provision require. Legacy validation error C2322 asks for the manager's POSITION in a box 11 that does not exist on form version 07, one of several signs that the error catalogue predates this form version.

Residual only: confirm whether the 3 % pension-accumulation contribution (employees in the additional accumulation scheme) is included in P3, and the legal basis of the Guarantee Fund and Long-term Employment Benefit Fund rates (read on the Sodra tariff page only). The question 'employer plus employee or one side only' is closed: P3 is the total rate (instruction point 55.5; MXFD/DSA carry one rate per person).

Residuals closed on 2026-10-30: (a) the 3 % pension-accumulation contribution (participants, Law IX-1691 art. 8(1)) is included in P3 - the Sodra tariff table gives a separate total 'Bendras su 3 % kaupimu' (e.g. 24,27 against 21,27); (b) in the month the 60 VDU ceiling is crossed the SAM keeps A12 = A11 x P3, Sodra recalculates that month automatically and notifies the employer of the person's new rate, which is P3 from the next month (Sodra page 'Įdarbinimas, pranešimai, įmokos ir tarifai', 2026-05-19; point 55.5). The rate Sodra notifies is authoritative for the months after the ceiling. Legal basis now read: Guarantee Fund 0,16 % (Law XII-2604 art. 5(3)) and Long-term Employment Benefit Fund 0,16 % (art. 14(3)), both charged on the income on which social insurance contributions are calculated. Position on the ceiling: I-1336 art. 10(9) applies the 0 % rate above 60 VDU only to contributions at rates approved by the annual budget-indicators law and excludes PSD; the Guarantee Fund, Long-term Employment Benefit Fund and 3 % rates are set by XII-2604 and IX-1691, so PSD 6,98 %, Guarantee Fund 0,16 %, Long-term Employment Benefit Fund 0,16 % and, for participants, 3 % continue above the ceiling. The question 'employer plus employee or one side only' is closed: P3 is the total rate (instruction point 55.5; MXFD/DSA carry one rate per person).

XML elements PaymentSum_1 to PaymentSum_6, Number, 2 dp, 11 characters. Point 55.2: the contribution amount calculated AT THE RATE STATED IN P3 ON THE INCOME STATED IN A11, in euro to the cent. Validation error C2344 states that A12 must equal A11 multiplied by the contribution rate, so A11, P3 and A12 must be reconciled line by line. Two statutory cases where the plain identity does not hold and the filling rule is still open: the annual ceiling of 60 VDU (I-1336 art. 10(9); 2026 EUR 138 729,00, 0 % above it except PSD) and the MMA minimum base (art. 10(7)-(8); 2026 EUR 1 153) - see Population Rules row 7.

TWO STATUTORY CASES BREAK THE PLAIN IDENTITY and must be designed for: (i) ANNUAL CEILING - Law I-1336 art. 10(9): contributions charged at the rates approved by the annual budget-indicators law (XV-632), excluding PSD, are computed on income up to 60 VDU per calendar year and a 0 % rate applies to the part above it; 2026: 60 x EUR 2 312,15 (XV-632 art. 4) = EUR 138 729,00. In the month the ceiling is crossed, and after it, A12 differs from A11 x full P3. (ii) MINIMUM BASE - I-1336 art. 10(7): where an employee under an employment contract is paid less than the minimum monthly wage (2026: EUR 1 153, Government resolution No. 700 of 2025-10-16), the employer additionally pays, from its own funds, the employee and employer VSD contributions on the difference up to the MMA, except where in that month the person was insured with another insurer (art. 4(1)-(4)) or under art. 6, received an old-age/disability/assistance pension, was aged up to 24, has a 0-55 % participation level, or received maternity/paternity/childcare benefit; art. 10(8) prorates the MMA by working days (5-day week) for non-insured periods and sickness benefit. How Sodra expects A11, P3 and A12 to be filled in cases (i) and (ii) is NOT stated in the SAM instruction or the DSA - open item for source research before the build.

(ii) MINIMUM BASE - I-1336 art. 10(7): where an employee under an employment contract is paid less than the minimum monthly wage (2026: EUR 1 153, Government resolution No. 700 of 2025-10-16), the employer additionally pays, from its own funds, the employee and employer VSD contributions on the difference up to the MMA, except where in that month the person was insured with another insurer (art. 4(1)-(4)) or under art. 6, received an old-age/disability/assistance pension, was aged up to 24, has a 0-55 % participation level, or received maternity/paternity/childcare benefit; art. 10(8) prorates the MMA by working days (5-day week) for non-insured periods and sickness benefit. Case (i), ceiling: A11, P3 and A12 follow points 55.1, 55.5 and 55.2 unchanged (A12 = A11 x P3, as C2344 checks). When a SAM, 1-SD, 2-SD or 13-SD brings the insured person's income to the ceiling, Sodra recalculates that month's VSD contributions automatically and informs every employer of that person, through the employer's Sodra account, of the change in the person's contribution rate; from the next month P3 is the rate so notified (point 55.5). LENGTH DIVERGENCE BETWEEN THE TWO OFFICIAL SOURCES: the DSA section 7 (p. 11) lists P3 TaxRate on SAM3SDP as 'Skaičius 11', while DSA section 6 (the same field on SAM3SD) and the MXFD (SAM-v07.mxfd, FormDef 2018-12-20, PageDef 3, FieldDataDef TaxRate_1..3, CellsInRowCount 5) give 5. Length kept at 5 (column I); a rate such as 21,27 fits both. Point 56.10: the general contribution rate applicable to the insured person DURING the period stated in A21 and A22. This differs materially from the SAM3SD rule in point 55.5, which fixes the rate as at the START OF THE CALENDAR MONTH: here the rate follows the period, so a rate change mid-month forces the period to be split into two lines, whereas on SAM3SD it would not change P3 at all. Reason codes 09 and 10 differ precisely in whether compulsory health insurance is payable, so they carry different rates and must not be merged. Added as a field by order V-624 of 2018-12-07.
